summary: Iteration 12 - frontend-only Playwright verification on mobile viewport (390x844) against preview https://bill-verify-7.preview.emergentagent.com with LIVE backend https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host. ALL 7 review-request flows PASS. (1) Sign-in with e2e_test_1786703401@example.com / Password123! lands on /dashboard. (2) GUIDED TOUR auto-opens on the dashboard (has_completed_tour was reset to false for this run): spotlight-tour modal renders, step 1 shows 'All your sites & contracts' with dots + Skip + Next controls (no Back on step 1). (3) Next -> step 2 'Snap any bill' with Back visible; Next -> step 3 'Hands-free renewal' with the last button labelled 'Got it'. Clicking 'Got it' closes the tour and calls PUT /api/me/preferences {has_completed_tour:true}. (4) After Sign out (profile-logout) -> Sign in again, tour does NOT auto-open (persistence works). (5) Profile -> 'Replay product tour' (profile-tour) navigates to /dashboard and REOPENS the tour. (6) On the reopened tour, Skip on step 1 (tour-skip) closes immediately with no crash / no red screen. (7) Business switcher chip is HIDDEN on Sites and Reports (single-business account): sites-business-chip count=0, reports-business-chip count=0; both screens render successfully (sites-header + reports-header visible, sites-error and reports-error counts=0). (8) /scan renders with 'Scan a bill' header + 'Take a photo' / 'Upload image or PDF' actions. /quote/new renders 'Get a Quote' step 1 of 3 wizard (Electric / Gas / Water / Telecoms chips + Continue). No pageerrors, no red screen. Only pre-existing web-only warnings unchanged from iteration 11 ('shadow*' -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents, and JS-based Animated fallback because RCTAnimation is expo-web-managed).

react_native_issues.issue: Web-only warning carried from prior iterations: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts
Web-only cosmetic warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/reports.tsx (watermark Text).

react_native_issues.component: Animated useNativeDriver on web (dashboard.tsx quick-action badge)
react_native_issues.issue: Web-only warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Non-blocking on web preview; native builds will use the native driver. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx QuickAction badge scale animation.

action_items: No fixes required. Optional cleanup: replace pointerEvents='none' with style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} on the Reports total-card watermark Text to silence a web-only deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: SpotlightTour (src/components/spotlight-tour.tsx) correctly gates Back (only shown when i>0) and swaps the Next button label to 'Got it' on the final step; step index resets to 0 whenever open flips to true, so Replay always starts on step 1.

Dashboard closeTour (dashboard.tsx:133) persists via PUT /me/preferences {has_completed_tour:true} for BOTH complete and skip paths - matches product intent (tour dismissed either way should not reopen automatically).
Auto-open guard uses tourTriggered ref + user.has_completed_tour===false check (dashboard.tsx:189-195), so signing back in after completion does not re-trigger.

Replay flow uses AsyncStorage flag TOUR_REPLAY_KEY read on focus (useFocusEffect at dashboard.tsx:168-180); Profile writes the flag then router.push('/dashboard'), which correctly re-opens because the dashboard stays mounted across tabs.

BusinessSwitcherChip (src/components/business-switcher-chip.tsx:34) short-circuits to null when businesses.length<=1 - verified at runtime for the test account (1 business => chip hidden on both Sites and Reports).
Scan (/app/frontend/app/scan/index.tsx) and Quote wizard (/app/frontend/app/quote/new.tsx) both render with a consistent ScreenHeader (title + back chevron) and no errors on web preview.
